facts.statement: Free Realms registered more than one million users, reaching the goal in 17 days.
facts.quote: Free Realms has registered more than one million users! It took only 17 days to reach this goal.

facts.statement: All current Free Realms players were rewarded with a limited-edition in-game T-shirt for their character to wear.
facts.quote: SOE is rewarding all current Free Realms players with limited edition, in-game T-shirt featuring special graphics.

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New? (One Million Registered Players!)
article_summaries.summary: SOE announced that Free Realms passed one million registered users, reaching the goal in 17 days. It describes the celebration rewards: a limited-edition in-game T-shirt for characters, a matching pet T-shirt, and Station Cash, with extra prizes for the one-millionth player. The post is dated only as '1 month, 2 weeks ago' relative to the June 2009 capture, so its exact date is unknown.
